label: Adopted Sartre’s "nervous condition" preface to Fanon to theorize gendered colonialism
description: Dangarembga titled Nervous Conditions directly after Sartre’s introduction to Fanon’s Wretched of the Earth, examining how colonial assimilation splits African women.
dialecticalTension: Expands existentialist anti-colonialism to encompass Shona patriarchy and bodily starvation.

label: Synthesized Fanonian colonial alienation with Zimbabwean feminist consciousness
description: Through Tambu and Nyasha, Dangarembga dramatized Fanon’s pathology of the colonized intellectual across gendered generational conflict.
dialecticalTension: Rewrites Fanon’s masculine colonized subject through Black women’s embodied rebellion.
